statuses.not-started: Inventory captured; visual and interaction rebuild has not started.
statuses.in-progress: Actively being rebuilt on this branch.
statuses.review: Implementation complete and awaiting visual, functional, and responsive acceptance.
statuses.complete: Acceptance criteria verified and evidence recorded.
statuses.blocked: Cannot proceed until the documented dependency or decision is resolved.

globalContracts.title: Route compatibility
globalContracts.requirement: Keep all 56 page paths, dynamic parameter names, deep links, redirects, and custom-domain/subdomain behavior compatible.

globalContracts.title: Tenant data isolation
globalContracts.requirement: Every league-derived read/write remains scoped to the resolved league and existing RLS/server authorization.

globalContracts.title: Authentication recovery and sessions
globalContracts.requirement: Preserve login, signup, recovery, callback, session refresh, and safe redirect behavior.

globalContracts.title: Role authorization
globalContracts.requirement: Player, captain, scorekeeper, and referee views enforce server-authoritative role and assignment boundaries.

globalContracts.title: Token portals
globalContracts.requirement: Token validation, expiry, rate limiting, cookie/session scope, replay protection, and noindex metadata remain intact.

globalContracts.title: League theming
globalContracts.requirement: Brand colours, logos, banners, template variants, light/dark behavior, and safe fallbacks remain configurable per league.

globalContracts.title: Website editor compatibility
globalContracts.requirement: Visible pages, custom navigation, preview postMessage updates, registration CTAs, ticker, sponsors, and custom content honor editor settings.

globalContracts.title: Payments and waivers
globalContracts.requirement: Server-calculated prices, Stripe states, signed waiver versions, idempotency, and ownership checks remain authoritative.

sharedRequirements.title: League shell
sharedRequirements.requirement: Header, desktop/mobile navigation, season/division context, score ticker, sponsors, footer/dock, account entry, announcements, and registration CTA are redesigned consistently.

sharedRequirements.title: Responsive behavior
sharedRequirements.requirement: Phone, tablet, and desktop layouts support dense hockey data without clipped controls or inaccessible hover-only actions.

sharedRequirements.title: Accessibility
sharedRequirements.requirement: Keyboard navigation, focus order, labels, contrast, reduced motion, semantic tables, dialogs, and status announcements meet WCAG-oriented acceptance.

sharedRequirements.title: System states
sharedRequirements.requirement: Every route deliberately covers loading, empty, partial, error, offline where applicable, unauthenticated, unauthorized, expired, subscription, and success states.

sharedRequirements.title: SEO and PWA
sharedRequirements.requirement: League-aware metadata, canonical/social images, structured data, sitemap/robots rules, manifest/install flows, and private-route noindex behavior are preserved.

sharedRequirements.title: Analytics and diagnostics
sharedRequirements.requirement: Consent-gated analytics, league attribution, Sentry capture, and bug-report context return without leaking personal or tenant data.

sharedRequirements.title: Timezone and locale
sharedRequirements.requirement: Dates and game times use each league timezone and copy remains ready for English/French requirements.

sharedRequirements.title: Performance
sharedRequirements.requirement: Images, live updates, tables, fonts, and animations are responsive and avoid unnecessary tenant-wide data loads.

workflow: Choose one route ID from this checklist and change only its manifest status to `in-progress` before implementation.
Rebuild the route against the listed sections, interactions, features, states, and contract IDs; reuse non-visual actions/data code only after confirming its authorization boundary.
Run `pnpm --filter @hockey-life/league-sites rebuild:test` and `pnpm --filter @hockey-life/league-sites rebuild:tracker` after any route/status change.
Move the route to `review`, capture desktop/mobile and state evidence, and run type-check, lint, and build.
Set `complete` only after visual, keyboard, responsive, error/empty/auth, and data-contract acceptance passes.
acceptanceCriteria: All 56 page routes still exist and each wrapper references exactly one matching manifest ID.
All 11 non-visual route handlers remain byte-for-byte untouched by the UI scaffold commit.
No files under `src/lib`, `src/hooks`, `src/providers`, middleware, Supabase, shared packages, or other apps change in the scaffold commit.
The route-coverage tests and live verifier pass and the generated checklist is current.
League-sites type-check, lint, and production build pass or any pre-existing baseline blocker is documented with exact output.
Each completed route has phone and desktop evidence plus loading, empty, error, auth/role, subscription, accessibility, and SEO review as applicable.
No secrets or real environment values are added to source, documentation, commits, or logs.
preservedBoundaries: `apps/league-sites/src/lib/**`, `src/hooks/**`, `src/providers/**`, `src/middleware.ts`, instrumentation, Sentry config, robots, and sitemap remain the source contracts for later reconnection.
`apps/league-sites/src/app/**/route.ts(x)` handlers remain operational code and are not UI placeholders.
`apps/league-builder`, `apps/mobile`, `apps/player-companion`, shared packages, Supabase migrations, lockfiles, and production infrastructure are out of scope.
The original production UI remains recoverable from `origin/production`, the pre-rebuild branch/tag, and the saved git bundle.
